'''Lychosik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] to [[Darth Arho]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
